Noise Texture Generator

Create seamless noise textures on a canvas: size, grain and opacity controls, with a real PNG download and data-URL output.

Noise Texture Generator

Canvas-generated film-grain noise — download as PNG or copy the data-URL.

Live preview

Data-URL (for CSS backgrounds)

📖 How to use

  1. Choose the texture size (256, 512 or 1024px).
  2. Set grain strength and overlay opacity.
  3. Toggle monochrome or colored noise.
  4. Preview live, then Download PNG or copy the data-URL.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I use it as an overlay?

Yes — an optional alpha channel overlay lets you use it as a semi-transparent grain over any design.

What does grain control?

A higher grain value means more contrast between the light and dark speckles.

Is the texture tileable?

All three sizes tile seamlessly when the pattern is generated, so they work as repeating CSS backgrounds.

Can I use the data-URL in CSS?

Yes — the data-URL is a standard PNG you can paste into any CSS background property.
